prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: If I were you, I would apologize first.
If I was you, I will apologize first.
If I am you, I would apologize first.
answer: If I were you, I would apologize first.

與現在事實相反的假設，主句要用 would＋原形，不用 will。
If I am you 是把假設當真實，與事實相反的假設應用 were。

why: 與現在事實相反的假設：If 子句用 were，主句用 would＋原形。
tip: 假設現在：If I were..., I would...。
say: If I were you, I would apologize first.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Had I knew about the delay, I would have taken the train.
Had I known about the delay, I would have taken the train.
Did I know about the delay, I would have taken the train.
answer: Had I known about the delay, I would have taken the train.

wrong.Had I knew about the delay, I would have: Had 後面要接過去分詞 known，不能接過去式 knew。
wrong.Did I know about the delay, I would have: 倒裝省略 if 時，過去的假設要用 Had＋p.p.，不能用 Did。

why: 與過去事實相反的假設可省略 if，把 Had 提到句首：Had I known...。
tip: 省略 if 的過去假設：Had + 主詞 + p.p.。
say: Had I known about the delay, I would have taken the train.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: If she _____ harder last year, she would have passed the exam.

wrong.studied: 與過去相反的假設，if 子句要用過去完成式 had studied。
wrong.would study: if 子句裡不能用 would，這是假設語氣的常見錯誤。

why: 主句是 would have passed，所以 if 子句要用 had＋過去分詞。
tip: 過去假設：if + had p.p., would have p.p.。
say: If she had studied harder last year, she would have passed the exam.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: I wish I _____ more time to finish the essay now.

wrong.have: wish 表示與現在事實相反的願望，要用過去式，不是 have。
wrong.would have: wish 後面的子句裡不用 would have 表達現在的願望。

why: I wish 後面接過去式，表示現在無法實現的願望。
tip: wish 現在的願望：過去式。
say: I wish I had more time to finish the essay now.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: Suppose the power _____ out during the show; what would you do?

wrong.goes: 後面的問句用 would，表示假設語氣，所以 Suppose 子句要用過去式。
wrong.will go: Suppose 子句裡不用 will，假設用過去式即可。

why: Suppose 表示「假設」，與 would 搭配時，子句用過去式。
tip: Suppose + 過去式, ... would...。
say: Suppose the power went out during the show; what would you do?

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Never I have seen such a moving performance.
Never have seen I such a moving performance.
Never have I seen such a moving performance.
answer: Never have I seen such a moving performance.

wrong.Never I have seen such a moving performa: Never 放句首時，後面要倒裝為 have I seen。
wrong.Never have seen I such a moving performa: 倒裝時只把助動詞放主詞前面，過去分詞 seen 要放在主詞後。

why: 否定副詞 never 放句首，助動詞要放在主詞之前。
tip: Never 開頭，後面倒裝：Never have I ...。
say: Never have I seen such a moving performance.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: Not only _____ the story entertaining, but it also teaches a lesson.

wrong.does: 句中的謂語是 be 動詞，Not only 倒裝時要用 is，不是 does。
wrong.has: has 要接過去分詞，這裡後面是形容詞 entertaining，要用 is。

why: Not only 放句首時要倒裝，原句 the story is entertaining 變成 is the story entertaining。
tip: Not only 開頭要倒裝。
say: Not only is the story entertaining, but it also teaches a lesson.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Hardly we had reached the station when the train left.
Hardly had we reached the station when the train left.
Hardly had we reached the station than the train left.
answer: Hardly had we reached the station when the train left.

wrong.Hardly we had reached the station when t: Hardly 放句首，後面要倒裝成 had we。
wrong.Hardly had we reached the station than t: Hardly 要搭配 when，than 是搭配 No sooner。

why: Hardly had + 主詞 + p.p. + when ... 表示「一……就……」。
tip: Hardly 搭配 when，No sooner 搭配 than。
say: Hardly had we reached the station when the train left.

prompt: 哪一句使用第一人稱敘事視角？
options: She could hear her heart pounding as she opened the door.
You could hear your heart pounding as you opened the door.
I could hear my heart pounding as I opened the door.
answer: I could hear my heart pounding as I opened the door.

wrong.She could hear her heart pounding as she: 用 she 敘述，是第三人稱視角。
wrong.You could hear your heart pounding as yo: 用 you 敘述，是第二人稱視角。

why: 第一人稱用 I 或 we，由故事中的人物親自說出經歷。
tip: 第一人稱 I、第二人稱 you、第三人稱 he/she。
say: I could hear my heart pounding as I opened the door.

prompt: 哪一句是用第三人稱敘述？
options: He walked slowly toward the old house.
I walked slowly toward the old house.
You walked slowly toward the old house.
answer: He walked slowly toward the old house.

I 是第一人稱，不是第三人稱。
You 是第二人稱，不是第三人稱。

why: 第三人稱敘述用 he、she、they 或人名，由旁觀者的角度說故事。
tip: 第三人稱敘事：he / she / they。
say: He walked slowly toward the old house.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: _____ the instructions carefully, Tom finished the experiment without mistakes.

wrong.Followed: Tom 是主動遵循指示的人，要用現在分詞 Following 表示主動。
wrong.Follow: 句首不能直接用原形動詞，要改成分詞構句。

why: 分詞構句的意思是主詞做的動作，主動關係用 V-ing。
tip: 主動用 V-ing，被動用 p.p.。
say: Following

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The window, _____ by the storm, had to be replaced.

wrong.breaking: window 是被風暴弄壞，是被動關係，要用 broken。
wrong.having broken: having broken 是主動完成，意思變成窗戶自己打破了風暴，不合理。

why: window 與 break 是被動關係，用過去分詞 broken。
tip: 被動關係：過去分詞。
say: The window, broken by the storm, had to be replaced.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Walking along the beach, I found a beautiful shell.
Walking along the beach, a beautiful shell was found by me.
Walked along the beach, I found a beautiful shell.
answer: Walking along the beach, I found a beautiful shell.

wrong.Walking along the beach, a beautiful she: Walking 的動作者應該是 I，但主詞變成 shell，造成懸垂分詞。
wrong.Walked along the beach, I found a beauti: I 是主動走路，要用 Walking，不用過去分詞 Walked。

why: 分詞構句的主詞要和主要子句的主詞一致，這裡都是 I。
tip: 分詞的動作者要與主詞相同。
say: Walking along the beach, I found a beautiful shell.

prompt: 「an omniscient narrator」指什麼樣的敘事者？
options: 只知道自己經歷的敘事者
知道所有角色內心想法的敘事者
完全不出現在故事中的旁白
answer: 知道所有角色內心想法的敘事者

wrong.只知道自己經歷的敘事者: omniscient 是「全知」，不是只知道自己的事。
wrong.完全不出現在故事中的旁白: 全知敘事者可以出現在故事外，但重點是知道所有人的想法。

why: omniscient 的意思是「全知的」，敘事者能看到所有角色的內心。
tip: omniscient = 全知。

prompt: 「an unreliable narrator」是什麼意思？
options: 一個不願意說話的敘事者
永遠說出完全真實的敘事者
敘述的內容可能有偏見或不實，讀者不能全信
answer: 敘述的內容可能有偏見或不實，讀者不能全信

wrong.一個不願意說話的敘事者: unreliable 是「不可信賴」，不是不說話。
wrong.永遠說出完全真實的敘事者: unreliable 是 reliable 的相反，不能保證是真實的。

why: unreliable 表示不可靠，讀者要自己判斷事實。
tip: unreliable narrator：別全信他說的。

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The author uses a flashback to _____ the hero's childhood.

wrong.reveals: to 後面接原形動詞，不能加 s。
wrong.revealing: to 在這裡是不定詞的 to，後面要接原形 reveal。

why: use A to V 表示「用 A 來做某事」，to 後接原形。
tip: use...to 後面接原形動詞。
say: The author uses a flashback to reveal the hero's childhood.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: It is essential that every student submits the form by Friday.
It is essential that every student submit the form by Friday.
It is essential that every student will submit the form by Friday.
answer: It is essential that every student submit the form by Friday.

wrong.It is essential that every student submi: essential 後面的 that 子句要用「原形動詞」，不加 s。
wrong.It is essential that every student will: 在表示要求或必要的形容詞後面，that 子句用原形，不用 will。

why: essential、vital 等表示必要的形容詞，that 子句用 (should) + 原形。
tip: It is essential that 主詞 + 原形。
say: It is essential that every student submit the form by Friday.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The manager demanded that the report _____ rewritten.

wrong.was: demand 後面的 that 子句要用原形動詞，不用 was。
wrong.is: demand 後面的 that 子句用原形 be，不用現在式 is。

why: demand、suggest、insist（要求）後面的 that 子句用原形動詞。
tip: demand that 主詞 + 原形。
say: The manager demanded that the report be rewritten.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 你很後悔出門時沒帶傘，淋濕了，想說「早知道就帶傘了」。
options: If I had known, I would have brought an umbrella.
If I knew, I would bring an umbrella.
If I had known, I would bring an umbrella.
answer: If I had known, I would have brought an umbrella.

用過去式 knew 和 would bring，指的是現在或未來，不是過去的遺憾。
wrong.If I had known, I would bring an umbrell: if 子句對了，但主句也要用 would have brought 才能表示過去。

why: 過去的遺憾要用過去完成式的假設：if + had p.p., would have p.p.。
tip: 對過去的遺憾：had p.p. / would have p.p.。
say: If I had known, I would have brought an umbrella.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 朋友在猶豫是否要換社團，你想用委婉的方式給建議：「如果我是你，我會再想一想。」
options: If I am you, I will think it over.
If I were you, I would think it over.
I were you, I think it over.
answer: If I were you, I would think it over.

給建議是假設語氣，要用 were 和 would。
缺少 If，主句也應該用 would think。

why: If I were you, I would... 是給建議的常用句型。
tip: 給建議：If I were you, I would...。
say: If I were you, I would think it over.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Without your help, I could not finish the project last week.
Without you help, I could not have finished the project.
Without your help, I could not have finished the project.
answer: Without your help, I could not have finished the project.

wrong.Without your help, I could not finish th: 過去的假設要用 could not have finished，不是 could not finish。
wrong.Without you help, I could not have finis: you 要改成所有格 your，後面才能接 help。

why: Without ... 可代替 If it had not been for ...，表達過去假設。
tip: Without 可以代替過去的假設。
say: Without your help, I could not have finished the project.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: But for the heavy rain, we _____ the match.

wrong.will win: But for the heavy rain 指過去的事實，不能用 will。
wrong.had won: But for 後的主句要用 would have p.p.，不是 had won。

why: But for ... 表示「要不是……」，主句用 would have + p.p.。
tip: But for 開頭，主句用 would have p.p.。
say: But for the heavy rain, we would have won the match.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: He is only fifteen, yet he talks as if he _____ everything about art.

wrong.knows: as if 用來說「好像」，與事實相反時，動詞用過去式。
wrong.has known: as if 與現在事實相反，用過去式 knew，不用完成式。

why: 他才十五歲卻說得好像什麼都懂，是與事實相反，用過去式。
tip: as if + 過去式：好像（其實不然）。
say: He is only fifteen, yet he talks as if he knew everything about art.

prompt: 這句話的真實情況是什麼？
text: Were it not for the noise, I could study here.
options: 這裡很安靜，所以我可以讀書
這裡有噪音，所以我不能在這裡讀書
answer: 這裡有噪音，所以我不能在這裡讀書

wrong.這裡很安靜，所以我可以讀書: Were it not for ... 是「要不是……」，表示事實上有噪音。
wrong.我不想在這裡讀書: 句子說的是因為噪音而不能讀，不是我不想讀。

why: Were it not for 等於 If it were not for，表示現在事實相反的假設。
tip: Were it not for = 要不是。

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Should you need any help, please call me.
Should you needs any help, please call me.
If should you need any help, please call me.
answer: Should you need any help, please call me.

wrong.Should you needs any help, please call m: Should 後面要接原形動詞，不能加 s。
wrong.If should you need any help, please call: Should 倒裝已經代替 if，不能同時用。

why: Should + 主詞 + 原形，是 If you should need 省略 If 後的倒裝句。
tip: Should 開頭的條件句：Should + 主詞 + 原形。
say: Should you need any help, please call me.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: _____ it to rain tomorrow, the match would be postponed.

wrong.Was: were to 的倒裝要用 Were，不用 Was。
wrong.Is: would 表示假設，不能搭配 Is。

why: If it were to rain 倒裝省略 if，就是 Were it to rain。
tip: Were + 主詞 + to V，是假設的倒裝。
say: Were it to rain tomorrow, the match would be postponed.

prompt: 「Time is a thief.」用了哪一種修辭？

wrong.明喻（simile）: 明喻會用 like 或 as 來比較；這句直接說 is，所以是暗喻。
wrong.反問（rhetorical question）: 這不是問句，沒有反問的形式。

why: 直接說 A 是 B，沒有 like 或 as，是暗喻。
tip: 直接說「是」的比喻是暗喻。
say: Time is a thief.

prompt: 「He is as brave as a lion.」用了哪一種修辭？

wrong.暗喻（metaphor）: 暗喻不用 as 或 like；這句用了 as ... as。
wrong.諷刺（irony）: 句子是在稱讚勇敢，沒有說反話。

why: as ... as 或 like 來比較兩件事，是明喻。
tip: as...as / like：明喻。

prompt: Tom 說這句話時，語氣是什麼？
text: "What lovely weather!" said Tom, as rain poured down.

wrong.誠心稱讚天氣: 雨一直下，lovely weather 不可能是誠心稱讚。
wrong.生氣地大聲吼叫: 句子沒有生氣大吼的線索，而是用相反的話表達不滿。

why: 話語和實際情況相反，是反諷（irony）。
tip: 說的和現實相反，就是反諷。
say: "What lovely weather!" said Tom, as rain poured down.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: She enjoys reading, writing, and _____ in her free time.

wrong.to paint: 平行結構要一致，前面是 V-ing，這裡也要 painting。
wrong.paints: paints 是動詞，不能放在 enjoys 的受詞列舉中。

why: enjoy 後面接 V-ing，三個並列項目要形式一致。
tip: 並列項目形式要一致。
say: She enjoys reading, writing, and painting in her free time.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The speech was brief, clear, and _____.

wrong.powerfully: 前面的 brief、clear 是形容詞，並列時要用形容詞 powerful。
wrong.power: power 是名詞，和前面的形容詞不平行。

why: be 動詞後的並列成分要詞性一致，都用形容詞。
tip: 平行結構：形容詞配形容詞。
say: The speech was brief, clear, and powerful.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Not until the lights went out we realized how late it was.
Not until the lights went out did we realize how late it was.
Not until did the lights went out we realize how late it was.
answer: Not until the lights went out did we realize how late it was.

wrong.Not until the lights went out we realize: Not until 放句首，主要子句需要倒裝成 did we realize。
wrong.Not until did the lights went out we rea: Not until 後面應先接完整子句 the lights went out，再接倒裝的主要子句。

why: Not until 子句放句首，後面的主要子句要倒裝。
tip: Not until ... 後面接倒裝句。
say: Not until the lights went out did we realize how late it was.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: So exhausted _____ that he fell asleep at his desk.

wrong.he was: So + 形容詞放句首時，後面要倒裝成 was he。
wrong.he is: 這是過去的事，且 So 放句首後要倒裝。

why: So exhausted was he that ... 是強調語氣的倒裝，原句為 He was so exhausted that ...。
tip: So + 形容詞放句首，be 動詞要提前。
say: So exhausted was he that he fell asleep at his desk.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 朋友邀你參加活動，你想說「我本來可以參加，可惜那天有事」。
options: I would have joined you, but I had other plans that day.
I had joined you, but I had other plans that day.
I will have joined you, but I had other plans that day.
answer: I would have joined you, but I had other plans that day.

wrong.I had joined you, but I had other plans: 表達「本來可以」要用 would have p.p.，不是 had joined。
wrong.I will have joined you, but I had other: will have joined 是未來完成式，不能表示過去的遺憾。

why: would have + p.p. 表示過去沒有成真的事。
tip: 過去沒成真：would have p.p.。
say: I would have joined you, but I had other plans that day.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The story is told _____ the eyes of a young girl.

wrong.at: at the eyes 是「在眼睛那裡」，不是敘事的視角。
wrong.on: on 表示在表面上，和「透過某人的眼睛」不同。

why: through the eyes of ... 表示「從……的視角」。
tip: through the eyes of = 從某人的角度。
say: The story is told through the eyes of a young girl.

prompt: 「point of view」在這句話中指什麼？
text: From the narrator's point of view, the village had never been so quiet.

wrong.景色最漂亮的位置: point of view 的意思是看事情的角度，不是景點。
wrong.村莊的位置: 句中 point of view 是敘事者所持的觀點，而非地點。

why: From ...'s point of view 表示「從某人的角度來看」。
tip: point of view = 觀點、視角。
say: From the narrator's point of view, the village had never been so quiet.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The more carefully you read, the better you understand the narrator's attitude.
The more carefully you read, the better do you understand the narrator's attitude.
More carefully you read, better you understand the narrator's attitude.
answer: The more carefully you read, the better you understand the narrator's attitude.

wrong.The more carefully you read, the better: the + 比較級的句型後面不倒裝，應是 the better you understand。
wrong.More carefully you read, better you unde: 少了兩個 the，不是正確的「越……越……」句型。

why: The + 比較級, the + 比較級，後面照一般語序。
tip: 越……越……：兩邊都加 the。
say: The more carefully you read, the better you understand the narrator's attitude.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The detective, _____ real name nobody knew, solved the case.

wrong.who: who 是主格，但後面的 real name 需要所有格 whose。
wrong.whom: whom 是受格，這裡需要所有格 whose。

why: whose 後面接名詞，表示「他的……」。
tip: whose + 名詞，表示所有關係。
say: The detective, whose real name nobody knew, solved the case.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The novel, that was written in 1920, is still popular.
The novel, was written in 1920, is still popular.
The novel, which was written in 1920, is still popular.
answer: The novel, which was written in 1920, is still popular.

wrong.The novel, that was written in 1920, is: 前面有逗號的補充說明子句不能用 that，要用 which。
wrong.The novel, was written in 1920, is still: 少了關係代名詞，兩個動詞 was 和 is 無法連在一起。

why: 非限定的補充說明子句要用逗號隔開，並用 which 或 who。
tip: 逗號後的關係子句不用 that。
say: The novel, which was written in 1920, is still popular.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 同學問你：「如果你是這本書的主角，你會怎麼做？」你想說你會說實話。
options: If I were the main character, I would tell the truth.
If I was the main character, I will tell the truth.
If I be the main character, I would tell the truth.
answer: If I were the main character, I would tell the truth.

wrong.If I was the main character, I will tell: 假設語氣的主句要用 would，不是 will。
wrong.If I be the main character, I would tell: If 子句的假設要用 were，不能用原形 be。

why: 對現在不真實的假設，用 If I were..., I would...。
tip: 假設自己是別人：If I were...。
say: If I were the main character, I would tell the truth.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: Had the hero _____ the map, he might have found the treasure.

wrong.studying: Had 後面要接過去分詞 studied，不是 V-ing。
wrong.study: Had 後面要接過去分詞，不能用原形。

why: Had + 主詞 + p.p. 是 If 省略後的倒裝，表示過去的假設。
tip: Had + 主詞 + p.p.：要是當時……。
say: Had the hero studied the map, he might have found the treasure.

prompt: 「a sarcastic tone」是什麼意思？
text: The narrator speaks in a sarcastic tone.

wrong.溫柔安慰的語氣: sarcastic 是諷刺的，不是安慰。
wrong.非常害羞的語氣: sarcastic 與害羞無關，是說話帶刺。

why: sarcastic 是「挖苦、諷刺的」，tone 是語氣。
tip: sarcastic = 諷刺的。
say: The narrator speaks in a sarcastic tone.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The author _____ readers to see the story through the child's eyes.

wrong.invite: 主詞 The author 是第三人稱單數，現在式動詞要加 s。
wrong.inviting: inviting 不能單獨當句子的動詞。

why: 第三人稱單數主詞搭配現在式動詞，要加 s。
tip: 第三人稱單數：動詞加 s。
say: The author invites readers to see the story through the child's eyes.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Although the plot was predictable, but the characters were memorable.
Although the plot was predictable, the characters were memorable.
Despite the plot was predictable, the characters were memorable.
answer: Although the plot was predictable, the characters were memorable.

wrong.Although the plot was predictable, but t: although 和 but 不能同時連接同一個句子，只留一個。
wrong.Despite the plot was predictable, the ch: despite 是介系詞，後面不能接完整子句，要用 although。

why: although 引導子句；despite 後面接名詞或 V-ing。
tip: although + 子句；despite + 名詞。
say: Although the plot was predictable, the characters were memorable.

prompt: 「foreshadow」在這句話中是什麼意思？
text: The dark clouds in the first chapter foreshadow the trouble to come.
options: 預示、暗示將要發生的事
answer: 預示、暗示將要發生的事

wrong.掩蓋、遮住: foreshadow 雖然有 shadow，但意思是預告，不是遮蓋。
wrong.回憶過去: 句中說的是 trouble to come（將要發生的麻煩），不是回憶。

why: fore- 表示「先前」，foreshadow 是在故事前面先留下伏筆。
tip: foreshadow = 埋下伏筆。
say: The dark clouds in the first chapter foreshadow the trouble to come.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 你在寫讀書心得，想說「這個結局讓我很意外」。
options: I was surprising by the ending.

表示人感到驚訝，要用 surprised，不是 surprising。
made me 後面接 surprised 描述人的感受，surprising 是形容事物。

why: 事物令人驚訝用 surprising，人感到驚訝用 surprised。
tip: 人用 -ed，物用 -ing。
say: The ending surprised me.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: Looking back, I wish I _____ a different choice.

wrong.made: wish 表示與過去事實相反，要用過去完成式 had made。
wrong.would make: would make 說的是現在或未來，不是對過去的後悔。

why: I wish + had p.p. 表示對過去事情的遺憾。
tip: 後悔過去：wish + had p.p.。
say: Looking back, I wish I had made a different choice.
